snippet.title: Tilting - get it on steam
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4710140/Tilting__A_Noir_Poker_Career/

A poker career game about climbing from backroom cash games toward televised events. Every buy-in is a decision about bankroll and reputation: sit at a table you can comfortably afford, or risk the roll on a room that pays better and punishes harder. Opponents are individuals, not odds, with tendencies and tells you learn to read across a session, and going broke costs you standing as well as money. Retro noirish presentation, pixel art at the table, painted portraits between hands, and a soundtrack that moves from lounge to synth as the stakes rise.
